project_type: Python orchestration engine (KiroCrew Flow) — multi-squad dev pipeline over Kiro Crew; aiohttp backend, hexagonal architecture (domain/ports/adapters/scan/engine/executor)
language: Python 3.12 (requires-python >=3.12). Code, comments, and docs are in Portuguese (pt-BR) — match that language in all new comments/docs.
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml. No compiled build. The Makefile targets are for the Kiro Crew app UI (npm), NOT for Python. Python deps installed with pip/uv.
test_framework: pytest + pytest-asyncio + pytest-cov. testpaths=['flow/tests'], addopts='-v'. Tests import deployment.deployment and flow.* directly.
build_command: python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]'  (installs pytest, pyyaml, etc.). Use a venv: python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'
test_command: .venv/bin/pytest -q   (or python3.12 -m pytest -q). ruff check . and mypy flow deployment for lint/type.
verification_instructions: 1) Create venv with python3.12 and install '.[dev]'. 2) Run full suite: pytest -q (currently ~630 tests per steering, must stay green). 3) ruff check . must have zero warnings. 4) mypy flow deployment with --ignore-missing-imports. 5) IMPORTANT: any new YAML field must parse under BOTH PyYAML AND the mini_yaml fallback in flow/config/squad.py — run the relevant squad tests with pyyaml uninstalled too (or add explicit tests exercising _mini_yaml).
snapshot_or_generated_files: app.json version is synced from pyproject via scripts/sync_app_version.py during semantic-release in CI only — do NOT touch. No test snapshots.
setup_instructions: System default python is 3.9; project needs 3.12. Use /root/.pyenv/shims/python3.12 (Python 3.12.14). Create venv: python3.12 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'. Network is OPEN_INTERNET so installs work.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET (installs allowed). Default `python3`/`pytest`/`ruff`/`mypy` on PATH resolve to Python 3.9 which cannot run this project — always invoke python3.12 (via venv). PyYAML is an optional extra; the parser has a hand-written mini_yaml fallback (flow/config/squad.py::_mini_yaml) that MUST also parse any new fields.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits drive semantic-release (feat->minor). Type must match: this is a feat. ruff zero-warnings, mypy clean, 75% min coverage per steering (.kiro/steering/arquitetura.md). aiohttp only — no FastAPI/Pydantic. Read .kiro/steering/arquitetura.md and .kiro/steering/fluxo.md before editing.
key_patterns: SquadConfig (flow/config/squad.py) already has per-repo resolver methods to MIRROR: auto_dispatch_for(repo, global)/auto_merge_for(repo, global) and auto_dispatch(repo_url)/auto_merge(repo_url) that resolve global internally via get_repo_config(repo). RepoConfig is @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) with name + auto_dispatch/auto_merge (None=inherit). Repos in 'repos:' can be plain strings OR maps with url/auto_dispatch/auto_merge (issue #264), normalized by _normalize_repo_identifier + _normalize_repos. load_squads_dir(directory) ALREADY EXISTS and skips files starting with '_' and 'example.yaml'. get_repo_config already handles the org/short-name matching subtlety. Azure DevOps is SCM-only (flow/adapters/scm/) — issue providers are only github|jira, enforced in _parse_squad.
relevant_files: flow/config/squad.py — RepoConfig, SquadConfig, _parse_squad, _normalize_repos, get_repo_config; ADD issue_provider to RepoConfig, parse it in _normalize_repos, add SquadConfig.issue_provider_for(repo). load_squads_dir already exists.

deployment/deployment.py — _load_config (line ~224) add squads_dir support keeping squad_config as fallback; _single_flow_tick (line ~4488) and _LedgerStateReader (line ~4322) + _LedgerDispatcher (line ~4363) must resolve provider per-repo via squad.issue_provider_for(repo) instead of a single root provider; also _resolve_squad_id (line ~4419) reads squad_config; the run()/_run_stage squad-loading blocks (line ~1681 and ~3392) read squad_config.
squads/example.yaml — add explicit comment 'Azure DevOps: apenas SCM, não issue provider' and document per-repo issue_provider override under repos:.
squads/kirocrew-flow.yaml — real squad config for reference.
config.example.yaml — document squads_dir for deployment (dir of squad yamls) and the onboarding flow (install app -> add squad yamls to ~/.kiro/crew/crons/squads/).
flow/ports/issue_provider.py — provider_for(name) maps 'github'|'jira' to adapter; unknown falls back to github.
flow/engine/ledger_tick.py — calls reader.read_state(run.repo, run.task_key) and dispatcher.dispatch_stage(run.repo, issue, current); repo is available at both call sites.
flow/tests/test_config_squad_workflow.py — squad parsing tests to extend.
directory_structure: flow/ = hexagonal core: domain/ (pure state+gates), ports/ (issue_provider Protocol + provider_for), adapters/ (github/jira issue providers + scm/ for github+azure SCM), scan/ (zero-token scanner + sqlite cache), engine/ (ledger_tick), executor/, config/ (squad.py + workflow.py), audit/, prompts/. deployment/deployment.py = the Kiro Crew script-cron entrypoints (run, run_dev/reviewer/merge/conflito, _single_flow_tick). squads/ = per-squad yaml configs (example.yaml + kirocrew-flow.yaml). config.example.yaml = deployment.config template. Tests in flow/tests/.
